title: Analista de Atração e Seleção Sênior
description:
Overview

A Zerezes nasceu do design, do seu olhar atento às pessoas, e da vontade de redesenhar o que não funciona. Acreditamos que os óculos são uma ferramenta de expressão do nosso estilo e personalidade, mas sabemos que essa não é a forma com ele é percebido pelas pessoas, que enxergam os óculos como algo funcional e pouco atraente. Queremos transformar o jeito que as pessoas compram e se relacionam com seus óculos de grau, porque achamos que dessa maneira, melhoramos não somente como elas se veem, mas também como se relacionam com o mundo. Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Atração e Seleção Sênior e a missão desse cargo será garantir a atração, seleção e contratação dos melhores talentos para o time comercial da Zerezes, com qualidade, velocidade e aderência à cultura, assegurando o funcionamento saudável das lojas e impactando diretamente os resultados do negócio.

  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores de recrutamento, identificando gargalos e propondo melhorias contínuas nos processos;
  • Elevar o nível de qualidade das entrevistas e avaliações, garantindo aderência técnica e cultural dos candidatos;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time de seleção, promovendo troca de conhecimento e disseminação de boas práticas;
  • Garantir uma experiência positiva para candidatos e stakeholders ao longo de toda a jornada de recrutamento;
  • Atuar como guardião da cultura organizacional, assegurando consistência e alinhamento nas contratações;
  • Contribuir com melhorias estruturais em processos, ferramentas e estratégias de atração de talentos.

  • Capacidade analítica apurada;
  • Forte senso de ownership e responsabilidade pelos resultados, atuando com protagonismo e visão de negócio;
  • Capacidade de influência e excelente interlocução com diferentes níveis de liderança;
  • Comunicação clara, objetiva e assertiva, com segurança na condução de alinhamentos e decisões;
  • Perfil proativo, com atitude “mão na massa”.
  • Alta organização e habilidade de priorização em ambientes de múltiplas demandas;
  • Excel Intermediário;
  • Ter atuado como Lider será um diferencial.

  • Habilidade de comunicação e negociação para interagir com fornecedores e clientes internos;

title: Senior Field Engineer
description:
Job Description

  • Ensure the Core Competencies of the greater organization are embraced.
  • Live the Rules: Treat the Life‑Saving Rules as non‑negotiable principles that guide your daily decisions and routines.
  • Lead by Example: Show your commitment through your actions and inspire others to do the same.
  • Speak Up: Act immediately if you see something unsafe or identify a potential risk. Empower one another to intervene with courage and care.
  • Educate and Share: Continue fostering conversations about the Life‑Saving Rules within your teams, ensuring everyone understands their importance and application.
  • Collaborate: Work together as One Team to make safety a shared responsibility, ensuring no one is left behind.
  • Goals: Focus on and execute your most important goals.
  • Vision: Together we will continue to enhance, grow and transform.

Non‑Negotiables

  • Ensure the Core Competencies of the greater organization are embraced.
  • Live the Rules: Treat the Life‑Saving Rules as non‑negotiable principles that guide your daily decisions and routines.
  • Lead by Example: Show your commitment through your actions and inspire others to do the same.
  • Speak Up: Act immediately if you see something unsafe or identify a potential risk. Empower one another to intervene with courage and care.
  • Educate and Share: Continue fostering conversations about the Life‑Saving Rules within your teams, ensuring everyone understands their importance and application.
  • Collaborate: Work together as One Team to make safety a shared responsibility, ensuring no one is left behind.
  • Goals: Focus on and execute your most important goals.
  • Vision: Together we will continue to enhance, grow and transform.

PROJECTS Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Work with the Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer to develop Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies for offshore and onshore projects.
  • Provide key inputs for engineering and planning to be developed.
  • Define and order equipment and installation aids.
  • Specify and identify suitable Pre‑Commissioning spreads and vessels.
  • Prepare Task Plans with support from Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer.
  • Review of Subcontractor Pre‑Commissioning procedures.
  • Prepare Readiness review, Constructability, HAZID.
  • Conduct site visits.
  • Prepare Master Equipment List.
  • Procurement of materials and services.
  • Interface with Pre‑Commissioning Subcontractor on deck layouts. Obtain seafastening packages for vessel spreads and interface with installation team.
  • Equipment inventory, preservation and staging for each mobilization.
  • Attend function tests.
  • Mobilize Pre‑Commissioning equipment and vessels to execute work scopes.
  • Arrange the testing and load‑out of Pre‑Commissioning equipment and installation aids.
  • Coordinate the execution of onshore & offshore Pre‑Commissioning work scopes.
  • Coordinate the demobilization of the Pre‑Commissioning equipment, marine spread and the off‑hire of subcontract equipment.
  • Work at site (onshore and offshore) as required by the project.
  • Prepare MOC's with support from Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer.
  • Compile and issue Site Memo’s and maintain system completion plan.
  • Compile and present return of experience and lesson learned documents.
  • To train and mentor Field Engineers.
  • Work with the Pre‑Commissioning Technical Authority to align on Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies.
  • Preparation of subcontractor scopes of works.
  • Manage Pre‑Commissioning subcontracts.
  • Daily Progress Reporting.

TENDERS Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Assists the Pre‑Commissioning Technical Authority in preparation of technical and commercial build‑ups following the Tendering work instruction.
  • Liaise with installation team during tender phase to ensure alignment on methodologies.
  • Work with the Lead Pre‑Commissioning Engineer to develop Pre‑Commissioning execution methodologies for offshore and onshore tenders.
  • Engineering and planning for the timely execution of the work scope.
  • Specify and identify suitable Pre‑Commissioning spreads and vessels.
  • Reviewing of internal and external deliverables (specifications, standards, drawings, reports, procedures, risk assessments, scopes of work, subcontracts).
  • Prepare installation aids requirements.
  • Prepare subcontractor/vendor scopes of works and subsequent technical bid clarification.
  • Prepare pre‑commissioning method statements where required.
  • To train and mentor Field Engineers.
  • Attend site visits where applicable.
  • Technical bid clarification.
  • Provide input into Technical Bid Evaluation process.

Interfaces

The Senior Field Engineer will maintain strong interfaces with the various disciplines within the business line. The main interfaces for Pre‑Commissioning are:

  • Marine Operations Engineers
  • Engineering
  • SCM
  • QHSES
  • Environmental Specialists
  • Vessel Operations Managers
  • Marine Construction Manager
  • Tender Manager

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • 7 plus years of experience in the oil and gas industry working for major Contractors.
  • Experience managing a team of more than 2 Engineers.
  • The following experience is required:
    • General experience of all shallow and deepwater water installation operations.
    • Rigid & flexible pipeline Pre‑Commissioning experience - execution of a minimum of 8 projects.
    • Umbilical pre‑commissioning experience - execution of a minimum of 4 projects.

  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de software e/ou engenharia de dados.
  • Capacidade de desenhar e implementar soluções de AI end‑to‑end, usando código, plataformas e ferramentas de forma pragmática.

title: Integrity Engineer
description:
Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Sumary:

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.
  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

title: Sr. Director of Pre-Award
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Senior Director of Pre-Award (Outgoing Team) leads the university’s pre-award research administration function, ensuring efficient, compliant, and service-oriented proposal development and submission. The role is responsible for managing all outgoing proposals, outgoing subawards, and consultant agreements, providing direct support to faculty and research administrators while maintaining consistent quality, compliance, and operational standards across the outgoing pre-award lifecycle. As a key leader in the Sponsored Programs Office (SPO), this position provides supervisory oversight of pre-award staff, works closely with institutional leadership, and aligns pre-award services with federal, sponsor, and institutional requirements.

Supervisory Authority

  • Directly supervises Pre-Award Research Administrators and administrative support staff, including setting priorities, managing workloads, and ensuring consistent application of standards across the team.
  • Provides oversight of outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements within the Sponsored Programs Office.
  • Provides training, mentorship, and professional development to pre-award staff to ensure continuous improvement in research administration, including coaching on performance expectations and process adherence.
  • Oversees faculty engagement and training efforts, ensuring faculty and research administrators receive guidance on proposal development and compliance.
  • Collaborates with the Senior Director of Pre-Award – Incoming team to establish best practices and ensure seamless pre-award operations.

Nature And Scope

  • Reports directly to the Assistant Vice President (AVP) of Sponsored Programs and works in close collaboration with the Senior Director of Pre-Award (Incoming team) to align pre-award strategy with the university’s research mission.
  • Serves as the primary point of contact for faculty and research centers on proposal development and submission.
  • Leads the university’s outgoing proposal and outgoing subaward administration, ensuring that all submissions meet sponsor, federal, and institutional requirements.
  • Engages with Post-Award teams, Research Compliance, and Legal to support seamless research administration processes.
  • Cross-Coverage Clause: While the Senior Director of the Outgoing team primarily oversees outgoing proposals and subawards, they are expected to cross-train and collaborate with the Senior Director of the Incoming team to ensure seamless research administration operations. In the absence of the Senior Director of the Incoming team, the Senior Director of the Outgoing team may assume temporary oversight of incoming awards and agreements to maintain compliance, efficiency, and sponsor relations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Leadership & Operations Management
    • Manages all outgoing proposals, subawards, and consultant agreements, ensuring timely and compliant submission and execution to federal, corporate, and foundation sponsors.
    • Implements workflow improvements and efficiency strategies to strengthen proposal development, intake quality, and routing discipline.
    • Establishes and enforces best practices and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for proposal development, submission, and outgoing agreement processing.
    • Monitors aging actions and escalates items at risk of deadline or compliance exposure, maintaining visibility into workload distribution and backlog status.
    • Serves as a liaison between faculty, research centers, and sponsors, ensuring successful proposal submission.
  • Proposal Development & Compliance
    • Provides technical assistance and strategic guidance for complex and high-value research proposals.
    • Reviews and ensures all outgoing proposals adhere to sponsor guidelines and university policies.
    • Oversees outgoing subaward and consultant agreements and compliance, including but not limited to pre-award subrecipient monitoring, required documentation, and risk assessments.
    • Maintains up-to-date knowledge of federal research regulations, including 2 CFR 200 and FAR/DFARS.
  • Faculty & Stakeholder Engagement
    • Develops and leads training programs for faculty, research administrators, and pre-award staff on proposal development, budgeting, and compliance.
    • Supports outreach initiatives to increase faculty participation in externally funded research.
    • Provides consultation and guidance to Principal Investigators (PIs) on proposal requirements and submission processes.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making & Performance Monitoring
    • Tracks proposal volume, success rates, sponsor trends, turnaround times, and backlog aging, using data to drive strategic and operational improvements.
    • Implements research analytics tools to measure performance and optimize pre-award workflows.

    • Leads process design, policy implementation, and operational strengthening across the outgoing pre-award function.

  • Proposal Development & Strategy: Strong understanding of sponsor priorities, funding trends, and proposal submission requirements.
  • Operational Process Design: Ability to build, document, and enforce repeatable workflows and SOPs that support consistent, compliant operations.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Extensive experience in grant and contract administration is essential and will carry more weight than advanced credentials.
  • 8+ years of experience in research administration, with at least 5 years in leadership roles, preferably within a central research administration office.
  • Leadership experience is crucial, particularly in guiding and stabilizing a team dedicated to contract and agreement administration.
  • Exceptional organizational skills are a must, with the capacity to handle multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the entire lifecycle of research award administration, from the proposal phase to the award set-up.
  • Experience with outgoing subaward and consultant agreement administration, including subrecipient monitoring and risk documentation.
  • Must possess a deep understanding of federal contract requirements.

Buscamos um profissional que queira participar ativamente da nossa expansão, mas que também preze pela excelência na gestão do que já construímos! description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The Assistant Director – Military and Veterans Services (ADMVS) directs, plans, and organizes all veterans’ services initiatives. The ADMVS assists with and helps lead the department's vision, goals, and objectives for the department. The ADMVS reports to the Director of Student Services.

Nature And Scope

The primary function of the ADMVS is to assume responsibility for most activities, procedures, and policies related to the Howard University Military connected community, including assisting with the department’s budget and staff. This position provides strategic direction for the assigned department under the general guidance of the Director of Student Services.

The position is responsible for implementing the policies and procedures to assist the Howard University Military & Veterans Community. The ADMVS performs the administrative and technical duties required to establish and maintain a program to assist Military connected individuals in obtaining educational, financial, social services and other benefits available through the Federal, State and local legislation. This position requires evening and weekend hours and accessibility as student needs arise.

Supervisory Accountability

Direct supervision of two Veterans Affairs Coordinators (Certifying School Officials). Supervision of one Veteran Resource Coordinator.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as point of contact for veteran's educational programs, policies, procedures and regulations
  • Serve as liaison between HU and the VA for eligibility for veteran students
  • Develop and expand the University's relationships with other U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and other services agencies
  • Provide accurate information to all interested parties regarding current educational benefits and programs which are provided by federal and state government and local agencies to support veterans
  • Counsel students and parents concerning eligibility and benefits available under various programs
  • Ensure compliance with federal and state government reporting requirements related to veterans’ educational benefits
  • Manage and monitor schedule changes, major changes, withdrawals, audits and inapplicable courses for appropriate changes in benefits
  • Implement control measures to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of certification
  • Establish and maintain student VA files
  • Coordinate with the office of Admission and Recruiting, Records and Registration, Financial Aid, and Disabilities Services to improve the enrollment process for military connected students
  • Recommend, implement, and administer methods and procedures to enhance recruitment efforts
  • Develop a working knowledge of ASU academic programs that are of interest to veterans’ students
  • Evaluate U.S. Armed Forces transcripts for transfer credit and transfer equivalencies
  • Develop and maintain the department's website
  • Represent the University on committees and advisory groups that work to advance and enhance VA benefits, and state and regional organizations that assist veteran students with four-year college graduation
  • Actively promote programs that engage veterans and the campus community
  • Perform other duties as assigned by Senior Leaders within The Office of Student Services and Student Affairs

Collaboration and Partnership

  • Partner with the Howard University Bursar’s office for seamless and streamlined communication
  • Collaborate and coordinate with the financial aid office
  • Provide recommendations, tools and resources for faculty and staff to assist them in how to support military connected students
  • Develop, cultivate, and sustain collaborative and effective working relationships with key stakeholders outside the Division of Student Affairs

Core Competencies

  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, critical thinking, professional judgment, oral and written communication
  • Demonstrated ability to work with a diverse and inclusive student population
  • Self-directed; self-motivated individual who can work autonomously with minimal supervision while managing multiple situations
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize, follow through, meet deadlines, and make professional decisions
  • Ability to work independently, collaboratively across multiple offices and in a team environment
  • Flexibility and accessibility particularly as it relates to responding to and attending to student needs
  • Demonstrated work ethic that illustrates integrity, ethics, sound professional judgment and an appreciation for diversity, equity, and inclusion
  • Competent and comfortable with technology and ability to utilize data to inform decisions
  • Strong writing, editing, and presentation skills
  • Ability to handle sensitive matters with exceptionally good judgment and discretion
  • Experience supervising employees, including hiring and evaluation

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in education, training, and experience
  • 3-5 years of experience with student support initiatives in higher education or a similar setting
  • Previous Military Services

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree in Counseling, Public Health, Education, Higher Education, Student Affairs, Social Work, or a related field
  • 5-7 years related experience
  • Ability to build knowledge base of national trends and best practices

Expected Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with SQL DBA expertise to join our data engineering team. This role will primarily focus on database administration (DBA) tasks such as optimization, performance tuning, and security.

The ideal candidate will have strong SQL database administration expertise. They will be responsible for understanding business needs, prioritizing work, leading daily standups, and effectively communicating technical solutions to stakeholders. While direct Power BI development is not required, the candidate should be able to guide and support the team’s work and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Primary DBA Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle) for performance, security, and availability.
  • Design and maintain database schemas, indexes, and partitions to support scalability and efficiency.
  • Perform database monitoring, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery planning.
  • Implement security best practices, including access control, encryption, and auditing.
  • Troubleshoot database performance issues and optimize query performance.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance, security policies, and industry standards.

Team Responsibilities

  • Participate in daily standups, prioritize tasks, and ensure alignment with business needs.
  • Translate business requirements into actionable data engineering tasks.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure that Power BI and data solutions meet business objectives.
  • Mentor team members and drive best practices in data management and reporting.

Qualifications

  • Strong SQL database administration expertise (performance tuning, security, backup/recovery).
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills to work with both technical and non-technical teams.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage a team’s workload while driving business objectives.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with a strong attention to detail.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and developer tooling to improve software delivery speed and quality.
  • Ability to use AI effectively for SQL performance tuning, database reliability validation, migration planning, and operational runbook automation.
  • Experience applying AI to testing workflows, including test scenario generation, regression coverage expansion, and edge‑case identification.
  • Proven ability to create practical automation that reduces manual effort while maintaining quality, security, and auditability.
  • Comfortable evaluating AI output quality, selecting the right model/tool for the task, and using secure patterns for sensitive data.
  • Track record of measurable efficiency gains (faster cycle times, improved stability, reduced operational toil, or better delivery predictability).

Engagement Model

  • This role will begin as a contract engagement with a planned path to full‑time conversion based on performance, impact, and organizational need.
  • We are looking for someone who can deliver quickly in a hands‑on environment and grow into long‑term technical leadership.

Additional Information

  • We are currently targeting candidates located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours.
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English.
  • M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization.

About The Team

The Core Services Team builds and maintains the mission‑critical, high‑throughput, and fault‑tolerant foundational services that power the entire Uber platform. This includes global‑scale services for Safety, Identity, Payments, and other core business logic.

What You’ll Do

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a technical leader who operates with a broad scope, influencing the technical direction not just within your team but across multiple dependent platform and product teams. You will drive the design and implementation of highly scalable, reliable, and performant distributed systems, setting a high bar for engineering excellence and mentoring senior engineers across the organization.

  • Lead the design and architecture of large‑scale, resilient backend services and distributed systems for core platform components (e.g., ensuring high availability, sub‑millisecond latency, and strict data consistency).
  • Own complex backend technical initiatives that impact major product areas or multiple infrastructure and cross‑platform engineering teams.
  • Drive technical decision‑making and establish architectural standards and patterns for the wider Core Services organization, focusing on scalability, security, and multi‑region fault tolerance.
  • Implement critical, high‑performance backend features and microservices using modern languages (e.g., Go, Java) and infrastructure (e.g., Kafka, Cassandra, Redis), ensuring they are secure and maintainable.
  • Champion a culture of operational excellence by establishing best practices for observability, proactive monitoring, automated load testing, and incident response.
  • Aggressively identify and resolve systemic technical debt, architectural bottlenecks, and non‑performant queries/logic across foundational backend systems.
  • Partner closely with Staff Engineers, Engineering Managers, and Product Managers to define technical roadmaps that align with long‑term business strategy, specifically regarding the evolution of our core service APIs and data models.
  • Represent the team and its technical strategy in cross‑organizational forums and drive consensus on complex technical tradeoffs between feature velocity, system stability, and infrastructure costs.
  • Act as a force multiplier by mentoring other backend engineers, elevating the technical capabilities and "systems thinking" of the entire organization.
  • Provide in‑depth, rigorous feedback in design and code reviews for critical systems, emphasizing distributed systems best practices, concurrency safety, and resource efficiency.
  • Contribute to the engineering culture by championing best practices in testing, CI/CD, and security‑first development.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, with significant experience in designing, building, and operating large‑scale, high‑availability distributed systems in a production environment.
  • Deep expertise in Backend Infrastructure: Strong mastery of microservices architecture, distributed databases, caching strategies, and asynchronous messaging systems.
  • Proven Leadership: Ability to lead multi‑quarter projects, break down ambiguous technical problems, and drive complex initiatives to successful completion across team boundaries.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • SRE Principles: Deep experience with site reliability engineering, including error budgeting, SLO/SLA definition, and building self‑healing systems.
  • Influence: A track record of influencing backend engineering strategy and architecture across different organizational boundaries and functional areas.

Overview

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes. O Hospital Cardoso Fontes é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atividades da especialidade de pneumologia, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, anamnese, exame físico, propedêutica instrumental;
  • Interpretar dados de exame clínico e exames complementares e diagnosticar estado de saúde;
  • Discutir diagnóstico, prognóstico, tratamento e prevenção com usuários, responsáveis e familiares;
  • Planejar e prescrever tratamento e praticar intervenções clínicas e cirúrgicas quando couber;
  • Prescrever medicamentos, hemoderivados e cuidados especiais;
  • Implementar ações para promoção da saúde, elaborar e avaliar prontuários, emitir receitas;
  • Participar de equipes interdisciplinares e multiprofissionais, realizando atividades em conjunto, tais como: discussão de casos, reuniões administrativas, matriciamento, entre outras;
  • Participar, conforme a política interna da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde (SMS), de projetos, cursos, eventos, comissões, convênios e programas de ensino, pesquisa e extensão;
  • Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade;
  • Participar de programa de treinamento, quando convocado;
  • Trabalhar segundo normas técnicas de segurança, qualidade, produtividade, higiene e preservação ambiental;
  • Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática;
  • Estar em consonância com as diretrizes de práticas médicas baseadas em evidências publicadas;
  • Preencher adequadamente e de forma legível todos os formulários padronizados pelo serviço manualmente ou de forma digital;
  • Registrar Estatística Internacional de Doenças (CID) e justificativas nos Serviços de Apoio Diagnóstico Terapêutico (SADT) e guias de referência;
  • Sinalizar prioridade de encaminhamento nas solicitações (alta, média ou baixa);
  • Realizar a contra referência do paciente à Unidade Básica de Saúde de sua referência após a alta ambulatorial ou durante o acompanhamento dos casos crônicos que permanecerem por mais tempo em acompanhamento no serviço conforme Código de Ética Médica;
  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD;
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Requisitos e qualificações

Graduação em Medicina com diploma reconhecido pelo MEC.

Residência médica em Pediatria em pneumologista

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.

title: Especialista em Operações Comerciais
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR) .

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

Reporting to the Director, Human Resources EMEA & SAL and based out of our factory in Rio de Janeiro, this role oversees all aspects of HR—including talent acquisition, compensation and benefits, learning and development, talent management, employee relations, policy design, and HR operations.

Operating as a primary business partner for the Rio manufacturing site and the wider regional business, the Senior Manager fosters a high-performance, employee-centric culture. This role emphasizes quality, productivity, and empowerment while ensuring all HR initiatives are aligned with global, regional, and local strategies to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Strategic HR Leadership & Business Partnership
    • Provide HR leadership and functional support across multiple departments, including Operations, Sourcing, Sales, Customer Service, and Legal.

  • Partner with leadership and regional Talent Development to counsel on employee impact decisions, supporting workforce planning, succession, and development initiatives.

    • Develop and implement HR policies and procedures, ensuring alignment with corporate guidelines.
    • Monitor and manage key HR metrics, providing data-driven insights for business decisions.

Candidate Experience and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will bring strategic HR leadership at both local and regional levels, with experience in fast-paced, evolving business environment.

A missão desse cargo será auxiliar na prestação de cuidados aos pacientes em um ambiente hospitalar. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem a assistência direta aos pacientes, a realização de procedimentos técnicos e a colaboração com a equipe de saúde.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar as rotinas de enfermagem da Instituição (passagem de plantão, registro de intercorrências, notificações de eventos, etc.);
  • Manter o posto de Enfermagem organizado para as atividades laborativas;
  • Receber, conferir, administrar e devolver as medicações prescritas;
  • Executar a Sistematização da Assistência de Enfermagem – Prescrição de Enfermagem e Plano de Cuidados;
  • Realizar os registros seguros da sua prática profissional;
  • Realizar curativo simples e comunicar ao enfermeiro;
  • Preparar o paciente para exames e tratamentos internos e externos, se houver necessidade;
  • Observar, reconhecer e descrever sinais e sintomas, ao nível de sua qualificação, sempre comunicando ao Enfermeiro.
  • Executar tratamentos especificamente prescritos, ou de rotina, além de outras atividades de enfermagem;
  • Ministrar medicamentos por via oral, IM e uso tópico relatando quaisquer alterações e/ou intercorrências ao Enfermeiro responsável;
  • Administrar nebulização, enema e calor ou frio conforme prescrição;
  • Realizar o controle de pacientes e contactantes de doenças transmissíveis, sob a supervisão do Enfermeiro;
  • Colher material (Urina e Fezes) para exames laboratoriais por método convencional;
  • Prestar cuidados de enfermagem pré e pós-procedimentos;
  • Executar atividades de limpeza e desinfecção de materiais;
  • Verificar e registrar sinais vitais para monitorar o estado de saúde dos pacientes, como temperatura, pressão arterial, pulso, respiração e glicemia capilar;
  • Realizar registros precisos das informações dos pacientes, incluindo sinais vitais, medicamentos administrados, procedimentos realizados e observações relevantes sobre o estado do paciente;
  • Apoiar na realização da contenção mecânica;
  • Realizar rondas conforme plano de cuidados;
  • Possuir escuta ativa e sensível;
  • Realizar manejo e abordagem aos pacientes com instabilidade psíquica;
  • Prestar cuidados de higiene e conforto ao paciente;
  • Zelar pela sua segurança, controle de pertences de riscos (giletes, fio dental, removedor esmalte, esmaltes etc.);
  • Auxiliar e incentivar a realização das atividades de vida diárias, tais como higiene pessoal, alimentação, mobilidade e eliminação;
  • Auxiliar no posicionamento dos pacientes confortavelmente na cama e movê-los com segurança quando necessário;
  • Realizar mudança de decúbito em paciente acamado;
  • Atuar sob supervisão do enfermeiro em intercorrências clínicas e psíquicas;
  • Auxiliar e incentivar na organização dos pertences e quarto dos pacientes;
  • Zelar pela limpeza e ordem dos materiais, de equipamentos e de dependências de unidades de saúde;
  • Oferecer apoio emocional aos pacientes, ouvindo suas preocupações e fornecendo conforto sempre que necessário. Buscando sempre um profissional da Equipe multidisciplinar e Enfermeiro em situações de saúde emocionalmente desafiadora;
  • Integrar a equipe de Saúde reportando todos os dados para o enfermeiro responsável pelo setor;
  • Realizar apoio e interação com toda equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Realizar observação contínua aos pacientes e relatar quaisquer alterações aos enfermeiros responsáveis.
  • Participar de atividades em saúde, seguindo prescrição de enfermagem e médica;
  • Auxiliar o Enfermeiro na execução dos programas de Educação para a Saúde;
  • Executar trabalhos de rotina vinculados à alta de pacientes;
  • Participar de procedimentos pós morte;
  • Realizar a coleta venosa e de secreção oro e nasofaringe. Preparo e realização do teste Toxicológico, Covid 19, entre outros testes não invasivos;
  • Entre outras rotinas pertinentes ao cargo.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Curso de auxiliar de enfermagem;
  • COREN de AUXILIAR DE ENFERMAGEM ativo;
  • Possuir experiência em saúde mental será um diferencial.

Informações adicionais

  • Gympass;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Vale transporte.

title: Patient Care Coordinator
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

This URL is for benefits and wellness: Function

The Patient Care Coordinator provides frontline administrative and clinical support to HIV primary care services, with a specialized focus on coordinating long-acting injectable HIV therapies. This role ensures seamless scheduling, medication tracking, patient engagement, and operational support to promote continuity of care and optimize viral suppression outcomes. The ideal candidate is highly organized, patient-centered, and experienced in clinical coordination within a fast-paced healthcare setting.

Supervisory Accountability

Involves no responsibility or authority for the direction of others.

Nature and Scope

External contacts include a variety of third party payers, medical organizations, patients and other healthcare personnel.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Maintain scheduling and tracking systems for long-acting injectable HIV medications.
  • Coordinate with clinical staff and specialty pharmacies to ensure timely medication procurement and dosing.
  • Monitor injection schedules and proactively address potential delays or barriers to care.
  • Assist with patient reminders, appointment confirmations, and follow-up outreach to reduce missed visits.
  • Perform patient check-in and check-out procedures.
  • Verify insurance eligibility and obtain necessary authorizations.
  • Coordinate referrals and follow up to ensure continuity of care.
  • Document patient interactions and care coordination activities in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR).
  • Support reporting initiatives related to patient engagement and viral suppression outcomes.
  • Collaborate with providers, nurses, case managers, and pharmacy partners.
  • Maintain accurate and confidential patient records.
  • Assist with daily clinic workflows to ensure efficient operations.
  • Support quality improvement initiatives and performance reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Attention to detail
  • Patient engagement and communication
  • Care coordination
  • Confidentiality and HIPAA compliance
  • Team collaboration
  • Problem-solving and proactive follow-up

Minimum Requirements

  • Current certification as a Medical Assistant (CMA or equivalent).
  • High school diploma or equivalent (Associate degree preferred).
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in a clinical or healthcare setting (HIV or infectious disease experience preferred).
  • Experience with EMR systems.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to patient-centered care and health equity.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$19.23 Hourly

description:
Company Description

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer - Node.JS at M3 Global Research , an M3 company.

About The Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications, delivering high‑quality data collection and project management capabilities covering quantitative and qualitative techniques.

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can thrive in a fast‑paced environment developing complex applications. The candidate will demonstrate an understanding of software development concepts, lifecycles using Agile methodologies, object‑oriented design, and accepted design patterns and practices. Responsibilities include

  • Lead and supervise the development team, ensuring projects are executed efficiently, aligned with Agile methodologies, and meet quality standards.
  • Design, implement, and deliver highly scalable solutions based on modern cloud‑based architecture.
  • Continuously develop, release, monitor, and improve our systems and services while fostering a culture of accountability.
  • Set and promote software development processes and best practices, providing mentorship to team members.
  • Participate in and facilitate Agile ceremonies, such as daily stand‑ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Provide regular status updates to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and clear communication of progress, roadblocks, and timelines.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers across the organization to shape high‑impact solutions and deliver high‑quality applications.
  • Take responsibility for the team’s deliverables, ensuring scope is maintained and work is delivered iteratively while embracing Agile principles.

Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in Node.js, with experience building scalable and efficient backend systems and APIs.
  • Knowledge of SQL and familiarity with relational databases such as Oracle.
  • Experience with modern front‑end frameworks, specifically React or Angular, and familiarity with Bootstrap for UI development.
  • Exposure to additional languages and frameworks such as PL/SQL, Java/JSP, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, PHP, Ruby, and ColdFusion is beneficial.
  • Proficient with source control tools like Git for collaborative development and versioning.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and familiarity with standards like OWASP Top Ten and SANS CWE, with a commitment to adapting to evolving security threats.
  • Team‑oriented with exceptional collaboration and communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional multitasking abilities, capable of balancing multiple projects and priorities effectively.
  • An analytical mindset with superior problem‑solving abilities and a strong inclination to learn and implement new techniques.
  • Familiarity with mobile‑first development and responsive design is a plus.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and coding tools that improve development velocity and software quality.
  • Ability to apply AI across the Node.js lifecycle, including implementation, refactoring, debugging, and unit/integration test creation.
  • Experience using AI to strengthen CI/CD and quality engineering practices (test generation, flaky test analysis, release validation, and review support).
  • Proven ability to design or integrate automation that increases team efficiency, reduces repetitive work, and improves delivery consistency.
  • Practical understanding of model selection, prompt strategy, output validation, and safe handling of proprietary or sensitive information.
  • Evidence of measurable outcomes from AI‑enabled engineering (faster delivery cycles, stronger test posture, and reduced production defects).

Additional Information

  • Applicants located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours.
  • We kindly ask that you submit your resume in English.

Nossa primeira loja nasceu em Madureira e, a partir da associação com empresários com a mesma vontade de fazer acontecer, inauguramos as demais lojas, sendo 7 lojas até agora. No Grupo Rezende, acreditamos que o sucesso é construído em família, com desenvolvimento contínuo e a capacitação de nossos colaboradores para que possamos crescer juntos.

  • Nossa Missão: Estar sempre disposto a ajudar o próximo, seja cliente ou colega de trabalho.

  • Nossos Valores: Dedicação, Humildade, Comprometimento, Alegria, Honestidade e Respeito.

O que esperamos de você?

Buscamos pessoas que compartilhem nossos valores e queiram fazer parte de uma empresa sólida. Você será um pessoa cheve para garantir que a experiência do cliente seja a melhor possível, garantindo um atendimento de qualidade, acolhimento e respeito!

title: Especialista de Inteligência e Relacionamento com Autoridades - Rio de Janeiro (RJ)
description:
Por que a Gabriel?

16.500 câmeras. 90 milhões de leituras de placa por mês. 1 alerta por minuto direto para a polícia. 650+ suspeitos indiciados. No Rio, nossa rede protege bairros inteiros com tecnologia integrada às forças policiais. Aqui você não apenas trabalha com tecnologia, você transforma dados em vidas protegidas e reduz a impunidade em cidades onde a segurança é direito de todos.

Por que essa vaga existe?

Nossa operação no Rio processa alto volume de demandas de delegacias, batalhões e guarda municipal. Absorver esse volume com agilidade, sem comprometer qualidade, é o desafio central dessa posição. Você será responsável por analisar ocorrências em tempo real, preparar evidências que aceleram investigações e garantir que cada alerta chega à polícia registrado, rastreável e pronto para ação.

Como a Gabriel remunera?

  • Nossa Remuneração: de R$150.800 a R$226.200 /ano (incluindo 13º salário e férias)
  • Nossos Benefícios (mais de R$35.000 anuais em benefícios):
    • Cuidado completo com a sua Saúde de maneira integral:
    • Plano de Saúde Alice com atendimento 24h pelo app, cobertura nacional e acesso a hospitais de referência no país - e sem coparticipação para os colaboradores. Cobrimos também 80% do valor dos seus dependentes.
    • Plano Odontológico da Odontoprev, para cuidar do seu sorriso e dos seus dependentes sem coparticipação.
    • Totalpass TP+1 custeado integralmente para você - para quem corre, caminha, "puxa ferro", faz yoga ou quem quer começar a se cuidar. Você pode adicionar até três dependentes.
    • Reembolso Saúde Mental: para cuidar também da sua saúde mental, reembolsamos até R$ 100,00 por sessão de psicoterapia.
    • Alimentação: Cada refeição importa, e a gente sabe. Oferecemos vale-refeição no Cartão Caju de R$ 922,00 por mês.
    • Benefício Educação: Seu crescimento impulsiona o nosso: reembolsamos 50% do valor que você investe na sua educação, limitado a até R$ 4.000/ano.
    • Auxílio Creche: Crianças de até 5 anos e 11 meses têm direito a auxílio-creche, para você poder focar no seu trabalho sabendo que quem você ama está bem cuidado.
    • Descanso de Aniversário, para você curtir sua data especial como preferir.

Responsabilidades principais

  • Análise de ocorrências é o coração do trabalho
    • Fornecer às autoridades competentes informações técnicas que aceleram investigações e ajudam a dar resposta concreta à sociedade - sem nunca substituir o trabalho investigativo, que é da autoridade pública;
    • Absorver alto volume de demandas simultâneas com agilidade, sem comprometer a qualidade - no RJ, o ritmo é intenso e a capacidade de priorização faz toda a diferença;
    • Acompanhar e registrar desfechos - cada suspeito indiciado, cada pessoa encontrada, cada caso resolvido com apoio das nossas imagens é uma métrica de impacto real.
  • Atendimento institucional a autoridades públicas
    • Atender demandas de delegacias, batalhões, Guardas Municipais e demais órgãos de segurança no RJ, recebendo e processando solicitações conforme os protocolos da empresa;
    • Apoiar o time existente na gestão do fluxo de atendimento, garantindo que o aumento de volume não comprometa prazos nem padrão de entrega;
    • Participar de Conselhos Comunitários de Segurança e espaços institucionais quando necessário, representando a Gabriel de forma transparente;
    • Reportar à liderança de Relações Institucionais e Governamentais, contribuindo com insumos operacionais para o planejamento da área.
  • Compliance como base de tudo
    • Garantir que toda interação com autoridades siga os protocolos formais da empresa: canais corporativos, ofício válido, registro em HubSpot, compartilhamento por link restrito;
    • Manter padrão de documentação que suporte auditoria - todas as comunicações são individualizadas, rastreáveis e revisadas periodicamente.
  • Colaboração com o time
    • Trabalhar junto ao time do RJ e à Central 24h, garantindo fluidez entre os casos que chegam por diferentes canais;
    • Contribuir com melhorias nos processos operacionais - quem está na linha de frente com volume alto é quem melhor enxerga gargalos e oportunidades;
    • Capacitar equipes internas quando necessário, compartilhando conhecimento sobre dinâmicas de segurança e boas práticas de análise.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência comprovada em análise de ocorrências, análise de vídeos ou avaliação de riscos em contexto de segurança;
  • Experiência em interação com autoridades públicas de segurança (Polícia Civil, Polícia Militar, Guarda Municipal ou equivalentes), com atuação pautada por protocolos formais;
  • Capacidade analítica forte e habilidade de priorizar sob pressão com alto volume de demandas simultâneas - esse é o diferencial central da posição;
  • Agilidade na execução sem perda de qualidade: a pessoa precisa ser rápida e precisa ao mesmo tempo;
  • Comunicação excelente, tanto escrita (documentação, relatórios, devolutivas a autoridades) quanto oral (interação com delegacias e times internos);
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de análise e edição de vídeo;
  • Segundo grau completo; bacharelado em Gestão de Riscos, Gestão de Segurança, Direito, Engenharia ou áreas afins será um diferencial.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com análise de imagens de videomonitoramento;
  • Experiência em ambiente operacional de segurança com alto volume;
  • Conhecimento do CRM HubSpot;
  • Experiência com melhoria de processos e fluxos operacionais;
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de segurança pública do Rio de Janeiro.

Mais informações

  • Modelo de contratação: presencial
  • Localização: Centro, Rio de Janeiro - RJ

The impact you can make: Your work connects our field operations to scientific validation, generating reliable, high-quality data to ensure our CO2 removal measurements are credible and scalable. title: Sr Geoscience Consultant
description:
The Role

Reporting to the Director of Onsite Subsurface Science and Engineering (SSE) services, the Senior Geoscience Consultant will be responsible for delivering dedicated and onsite services to a large National Oil Company.

The successful candidate for this key role will be part of an early adopter program, tasked with ensuring a continuous and evolving customer adoption of a cloud-native, AI agentic-ready environment to accelerate subsurface projects that operate on industry standard (OSDU) data structures to automate workflows and accelerate subsurface decision‑making.

In this role, the successful candidate will work closely with oil company geoscientists to define, implement, and execute repeatable workstreams that will improve customer productivity and accelerate and qualify upstream decisions. Workstreams can include project screening and evaluation of data, new venture workflows for rapid prospect evaluation and review, rapid and highly integrated structural and facies model building, and uncertainty screening. AI‑assisted queries can be applied to all workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Work closely with customer geoscientists in building, executing, refining, and documenting workstreams that improve customer decision making, and productivity.
  • Ensure continuous and optimized customer use of an agentic AI software solution to conduct and execute those workstreams.
  • Provide loyalty‑inspiring on‑site customer services that drive user engagement and sustain product usage.
  • Document customer successes and pain points and communicate them to project managers, R&D, and service personnel.
  • Develop an understanding of customer business challenges and requirements.
  • Manage customer expectations and relationships through regular meetings and communications.
  • Prepare and present technical reports, presentations, and recommendations to customer and to AspenTech stakeholders.
  • Work in close collaboration with your supervisor, customer geoscientists, and colleagues to ensure effective coordination and successful delivery of project activities.
  • Conduct projects through final delivery and report writing.

What You'll Need

  • 5 to 8 years of industry experience as a Geomodeller and Geologist in the oil and gas industry.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Geology, Computational Geology, Structural Geology or related Geoscience discipline.
  • Experience in defining structural, stratigraphic, and depositional frameworks and identifying trap geometries and reservoir distribution.
  • Experience in building geomodels including structural models, property models, and facies models.
  • Working understanding seismic interpretation, reservoir characterization, and petrophysical analysis workflows.
  • Experience with applying AI methods to subsurface projects.
  • Experience with or knowledge of industry open platforms like OSDU.
  • Experience with operating application software in a Cloud, considered a plus.
  • Ability to navigate smoothly within modern application software interfaces, incorporating multi‑tasking of activities and operations.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills to resolve complex technical issues and capability to prioritize tasks.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to convey complex technical concepts to a variety of audiences.
  • Ability to identify opportunities that create value for customers with a strong customer first mindset.
  • Ability to proactively take the lead in resolving complex technical issues and/or difficult organisational problems with an innovative approach.
  • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and competing priorities.
  • Experience with Python scripting considered a plus.
  • Experience with Formation Evaluation Solutions (e.g., Geolog), Seismic Characterization Solutions (e.g., SeisEarth), and Geomodelling solutions (e.g., SKUA, RMS) from AspenTech considered a plus.

A Duetti está redefinindo a forma como criadores independentes de música monetizam e expandem suas carreiras. Apoiando-se em investidores de destaque como The Raine Group, Flexpoint Ford, Nyca Partners, Viola Ventures e Roc Nation, a Duetti já levantou mais de US$ 635 milhões em capital para financiar criadores independentes. Impulsionada pela crença na independência e no empoderamento financeiro, a Duetti está construindo um futuro mais sustentável para criadores de música em todo o mundo. Com escritórios em Nova York, Los Angeles, Miami e Londres, a Duetti oferece benefícios competitivos, política flexível de folgas remuneradas e um modelo de trabalho híbrido. Você terá um papel essencial na formulação e execução da estratégia de A&R da Duetti, colaborando de perto com a liderança sênior da empresa. title: Consultoria para Soluções Automatizadas de Monitoramento e Dados de Comunicação
description:
SOBRE O CPI

O Climate Policy Initiative (CPI) é uma organização com experiência internacional em análise de políticas públicas e finanças, que possui sete escritórios ao redor do mundo. No Brasil, é afiliado à Pontifícia Universidade Católica do Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio). O CPI/PUC-Rio atua no aprimoramento de políticas públicas e financiamento climático no Brasil através de análises baseadas em evidência e parcerias estratégicas com membros do governo, da sociedade civil, do setor privado e de instituições financeiras.

ESCOPO

  • Coleta automatizada de métricas de redes sociais e dashboard analítico: desenvolver solução para coleta automatizada de métricas de LinkedIn e Instagram, utilizando as APIs oficiais das plataformas, contemplando todos os canais digitais do CPI, estruturando os dados e criando um dashboard para visualização e análise dos indicadores.
  • Sistema de coleta de menções ao CPI e dashboard de clipping: desenvolver sistema para coleta, organização e mensuração de menções ao CPI Brasil e aos seus pesquisadores na imprensa nacional, internacional e em meios digitais, incluindo portais de notícias, blogs e redes sociais, com capacidade de atualização e inclusão de novos termos, e incluir dashboard para consolidação e visualização das menções coletadas.
  • Ferramenta de monitoramento de palavras-chave e dashboard de monitoramento (social listening): desenvolver solução para monitoramento contínuo de palavras-chave relevantes ao CPI em imprensa e meios digitais, com capacidade de atualização e inclusão de novos termos.

As soluções devem ser replicáveis, atualizáveis e permitir a inclusão de novos termos e fontes.

ENTREGÁVEIS

A Consultoria Deverá Entregar:

  • Solução de coleta de métricas de redes sociais: sistema automatizado para extração e organização periódica de métricas de LinkedIn e Instagram, envolvendo múltiplas contas/perfis, consolidação e comparação de dados entre canais, métricas de alcance, impressões, engajamento, interações e seguidores, alinhadas às necessidades do CPI, com dashboard analítico contendo KPIs, visualizações de tendência, filtros por período, plataforma e canal, e interface acessível para a equipe de comunicação.
  • Sistema de coleta e mensuração de menções ao CPI Brasil: ferramenta para identificação, coleta e organização de menções ao CPI Brasil e aos seus pesquisadores na imprensa e em meios digitais, consolidando menções de diferentes fontes, organizando-as de forma estruturada (veículo, data, link, autor, tipo de mídia), mensurando volume de menções e alcance/audiência quando disponível, e permitindo consolidação e consulta dos dados ao longo do tempo, com dashboard de clipping visualizando volume ao longo do tempo, distribuição por tipo de mídia/fonte, filtros por período e variáveis relevantes, interface acessível para a equipe de comunicação.
  • Ferramenta de monitoramento de palavras-chave: solução contínua para monitoramento de palavras-chave relevantes ao CPI em imprensa e meios digitais, permitindo acompanhamento de termos definidos pelo CPI, coleta e organização de menções, inclusão e atualização de termos ao longo do tempo, estruturação de dados para análise de tendências e volume de menções, com dashboard estruturado exibindo volume por palavra-chave ao longo do tempo, comparação entre termos monitorados, filtros por período e fonte, interface acessível para a equipe de comunicação.

Obs.: Todas as entregas devem incluir documentação simples de uso e atualização. As soluções desenvolvidas deverão permitir a inclusão e atualização de novos canais, fontes e termos de monitoramento pelo CPI, sem necessidade de alterações estruturais ou suporte contínuo do(a) consultor(a).

CRONOGRAMA

Duração total: 3 meses.

  • Mês 1: Entrega da solução de métricas de redes sociais.
  • Mês 2: Entrega da solução de coleta de menções ao CPI Brasil.
  • Mês 3: Entrega da plataforma de social listening.

Pagamentos vinculados à entrega e aprovação de cada etapa.

DOCUMENTAÇÃO DOS ENTREGÁVEIS

A documentação clara, completa e bem estruturada é parte integrante de cada produto entregue. Não serão aceitos produtos sem documentação adequada.

  • Descrição da arquitetura da solução implementada.
  • Instruções de configuração e dependências (bibliotecas, credenciais, tokens de API).
  • Guia de uso para usuários finais em linguagem acessível.
  • Manual de manutenção técnica, incluindo procedimentos para atualização de integrações, renovação de credenciais e resolução de problemas comuns.
  • Registro de limitações técnicas e recomendações para melhorias futuras.

A documentação deverá ser suficiente para garantir a operação, atualização e manutenção das soluções de forma autônoma pela equipe do CPI, com orientações claras para inclusão de novos canais, fontes e termos de monitoramento, sem dependência do(a) consultor(a). Os entregáveis deverão ser fornecidos em formato digital, em arquivo aberto (editável), conforme a natureza de cada produto.

QUALIFICAÇÕES

Obrigatórias:

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em IA e/ou automação de dados.
  • Experiência com integração de APIs (especialmente redes sociais).
  • Experiência em coleta e estruturação de dados digitais em larga escala.

Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com NLP (processamento de linguagem natural) para análise de texto.
  • Experiência com social listening e/ou clipping automatizado.
  • Conhecimento em Python ou linguagens similares.

CONSIDERAÇÕES FINAIS

A execução dos trabalhos não implica relação de emprego ou vínculo trabalhista com o CPI/PUC-Rio.

title: Transport Client Services Manager
description:
Transport Client Services Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Transport Client Services Manager role exists both tactical (pre‑Tournament) and operationally (Tournament time) – shifting from planning & relationship management to execution & issue resolution.

The Transport Client Service Manager is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, and delivery of transport services for designated client groups during FWWC2027. Acting as the primary liaison between the Transport Functional Area and key stakeholders (such as FIFA Constituent Groups including; Teams, Referees, FIFA Senior Officials, Delegates and Guests, Workforce, Media & Broadcast and Commercial Affiliates), the role ensures that client transport requirements are accurately captured, planned, and operationally delivered in alignment with the FIFA Transport Operating Concept.

During the pre‑Tournament phase, the Manager oversees client engagement, gathers and validates detailed mobility requirements, and translates these into Service Level Agreements (SLAs). The role is responsible for delivering the Detailed Service Level Agreements (DSLAs) according to agreed timelines and for gaining the necessary agreements and approvals, ensuring that the role works cross‑functionally with fleet planning, Venue and Arrivals and Departures Teams to ensure feasibility, readiness, and service alignment. The position also contributes to test events, readiness exercises, and data accuracy.

During Tournament time, the Transport Client Service Manager becomes the operational lead for assigned client groups, monitoring service performance, managing daily communications, resolving issues in real time, and coordinating adjustments from the Transport Operations Center. The role is accountable for maintaining service reliability, managing escalations, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction in a fast‑paced, high‑pressure environment.

In addition to the above, the role will provide support for the following Event Transport sub‑projects planning and implementation:

  • Developing Transport policies, procedures, Operational Plan and reports.
  • To build, train and motivate the Client Services team of paid staff and volunteers for the duration of the FWWC2027 Tournament.

The successful candidate is expected to be a self‑starter and multitasker who works well under pressure, can lead and manage a team and delivers to strict timelines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Recruit, manage and lead a team of Client Service.
  • Coordinate the transport and arrivals and departures service planning for each client group as named above to ensure the correct services, in accordance with FIFA service levels are planned for each client group to ensure the overall success of the tournament.
  • Liaison, in coordination with other transport stakeholders, with all transport mode suppliers including bus, fleet and public transport and other key functional areas to develop the services.
  • Direct the delivery of the Detailed Service Level Agreements (DSLAs), per client group. Ensure all agreements and necessary approvals are gained with client owners, transport service delivery functions both internal to FWWC2027 and external partners / suppliers and FIFA.
  • Lead the client services team to ensure all client service level planning is integrated with other key FWWC2027 functional areas at site and venue level including all stadiums and non‑competition sites.
  • Lead on ensuring the DSLAs are fully integrated with all concerned stakeholders.
  • Work closely with other transport team members (Bus, Fleet and Venues) to ensure the most efficient services are planned and delivered for each client group in line with agreed budgets.
  • Always with the aim of delivering the best client experience and optimising efficiencies where possible.
  • Lead on the delivery of all clients related information, communications and presentations at key client meetings plus any client transport guides/information and other related documents, both electronic and published.
  • Lead on the planning, staffing and management of VIP and FIFA hotels operations including planning of all resources and the recruitment and training of transport desk staff.
  • Support delivery of Transport for all test events prior to the FWWC2027.
  • Work with Senior Transport Management team to prepare risk analysis and develop mitigation strategies for each client group.
  • Act as the primary transport liaison for assigned client groups, maintaining daily engagement and providing operational updates.
  • Monitor transport service performance (fleet allocation, on‑time performance, demand vs. capacity) and initiate real‑time adjustments as required.
  • Manage and resolve operational issues, delays, last‑minute schedule changes, and escalations affecting client transport services.
  • Oversee major peak movements, including arrivals, departures, and high‑profile competition or ceremony transport waves.
  • Provide daily reporting on service levels, incidents, and client feedback, ensuring transparency and continuous operational improvement.
  • Safeguard client satisfaction while ensuring services remain aligned with approved entitlements and operational constraints.

YOUR PROFILE

Qualifications

  • Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/Civil Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of event transport experience in international major events in at least two (2) world‑class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games/Expo. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time critical project.
  • Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Proven experience of managing fleet services and operations projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships.

Skills

  • Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles.
  • Advanced knowledge of teams’ leadership, business process management.
  • Advanced communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, the ability to influence others and manage relationships.
  • Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment.
  • Knowledge of Event Transportation technical operating processes and activities.
  • Ability to motivate others toward a common goal and manage a multidisciplinary team through conflicting priorities and continuous change requests.
  • Ability to work and communicate in a corporate and project focused organisation.
  • Proven project management skills within a complex project.
  • Strong analytical and organisation skills.
  • Strong IT skills; familiarity and comfort with MS Office (especially MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Proven solution orientated decision‑making skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure to immutable deadlines.

Requirements

  • Must have legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro.
  • Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus.
