title: Analista de Planejamento Comercial
description:
Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Há 20 anos, somos movidos por um único objetivo: transformar vidas por meio da educação . Somos uma família de professores, coordenadores, diretores e colaboradores que acreditam na educação como a melhor maneira de formar crianças e jovens vencedores, capazes de conquistar seu próprio sucesso, no campo em que desejarem.

Juntos com nossos mais de 27 mil alunos e familiares, formamos uma família ainda maior e com valores fortes, vividos a todo momento em cada uma das nossas escolas – AMOR, GARRA, FOCO e MÉRITO .

A posição de Analista Comercial tem como missão transformar dados em decisões estratégicas, apoiando as escolas da rede ao longo de todo o ciclo comercial — da captação à retenção de alunos. Atua como elo entre dados e estratégia, trabalhando de forma próxima à liderança e às unidades para impulsionar crescimento sustentável e reduzir a evasão.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Suporte à força de vendas: Apoiar as equipes comerciais das unidades por meio da análise de dados e disponibilização de relatórios gerenciais que orientem a atuação no dia a dia.
  • Análise de performance e indicadores: Monitorar resultados comerciais e indicadores-chave (KPIs), gerando insights acionáveis para apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Gestão de campanhas de captação: Acompanhar campanhas em parceria com o time de Marketing, analisando o funil de matrículas (leads, conversão e volume), além de apoiar as unidades nos atendimentos relacionados.
  • Gestão de rematrícula e retenção: Monitorar o funil de rematrícula das unidades, identificando oportunidades de melhoria para redução de evasão (churn) e aumento da permanência dos alunos (LTV).
  • Evolução de processos e analytics: Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos comerciais, promovendo automação de rotinas e aumento da maturidade analítica da área.
  • Análises e iniciativas comerciais: Apoiar a construção e análise de materiais estratégicos do ciclo comercial, incluindo mutirões, campanhas (como Salta Pontos) e demais iniciativas de alavancagem de resultados.
  • Gestão de canais de atendimento: Atuar como responsável pela operação do Blip, garantindo eficiência no atendimento e qualidade na jornada do cliente.

Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas
  • Experiência prévia em SalesOps, FP&A, planejamento financeiro ou áreas analíticas
  • Domínio de Excel (nível avançado)
  • Vivência na construção de relatórios, análises financeiras e apresentações executivas
  • Capacidade analítica, organização e atenção a detalhes
  • Boa comunicação para traduzir números em recomendações claras para o negócio

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com área Comercial, Vendas ou Revenue
  • Conhecimento em Power BI, Looker, Tableau ou ferramentas similares
  • Vivência em empresas de serviços, educação, varejo ou ambientes de crescimento acelerado

Sobre o Elite

Presentes em Belo Horizonte, Distrito Federal, Goiás, Mato Grosso do Sul, Paraná, Santa Catarina, São Paulo e Rio de Janeiro, há 20 anos, somos a escola responsável por transformar vidas por meio da educação. Com os nossos mais de 27 mil alunos e familiares, formamos uma família ainda maior e com valores fortes, vividos a todo momento em cada uma das nossas escolas – AMOR, GARRA, FOCO e MÉRITO.

A jornada é estruturada para acelerar o desenvolvimento técnico, comercial e estratégico do profissional, que desde o primeiro dia já atua como Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI.

  • 1º mês | Onboarding

  • 2º mês | Prospecção
  • Início da atuação comercial supervisionada, com foco na geração de oportunidades. O profissional realiza prospecção ativa, qualificação de leads, participa de reuniões e estrutura seu pipeline, evoluindo na condução de conversas estratégicas com investidores.

  • Meses seguintes | Alocação e Consolidação
  • Momento de fortalecimento e expansão da carteira, com definição de estratégias de investimento, adequação de produtos ao perfil do cliente e aprofundamento do relacionamento de longo prazo.

Por que escolher a EQI?

title: Executive Director, Physical Facilities Management
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Executive Director of Physical Facilities Management (PFM) provides strategic leadership and operational oversight of Howard University’s facilities operations and physical assets. Reporting to the Vice President for Capital Planning & Facilities Management, the Executive Director is responsible for directing daily facilities operations, overseeing multimillion-dollar budgets, managing external service contracts, and guiding University-wide space planning. This position ensures that the University’s buildings, infrastructure, and grounds are safe, reliable, efficient, and aligned with Howard’s mission and long-term strategic priorities.

Supervisory Authority

Supervises directors, managers, professional staff, skilled trades, custodial teams, contractors, and other personnel engaged in facilities management and space planning.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include senior leadership, academic deans, and administrative units to ensure facilities operations and space utilization align with institutional priorities. External contacts include architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, utilities, and regulatory agencies to oversee compliance, project execution, and contractual agreements. The role also requires close collaboration with Howard University Hospital and inter‑agency partners, as joint projects and shared facilities work will be prevalent.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Provides leadership for daily operations of maintenance, custodial services, grounds, utilities, and building systems, ensuring service quality, responsiveness, and safety.
  • Oversees financial management of PFM operations, including budget development, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost control for operating and capital funds.
  • Administers major vendor and service contracts for custodial, maintenance, utilities, and energy procurement, ensuring performance accountability and fiscal soundness.
  • Directs allocation, planning, and utilization of University building space to support academic, residential, and administrative priorities.
  • Guides preventive and deferred maintenance programs, sustainability initiatives, and capital renewal efforts to extend the life of University assets.
  • Ensures compliance with OSHA, EPA, fire/life safety, and all applicable local, state, and federal regulations.
  • Establishes key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure operational efficiency, contractor performance, timeliness and quality of work, and customer satisfaction.
  • Provides strong customer service, fostering collaboration and timely communication across the University with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Serves as the University’s representative in negotiations with external vendors, contractors, and government agencies on facilities‑related matters.
  • Collaborates with Capital Planning & Facilities Management leadership to align space management, renovations, and new construction with institutional priorities.
  • Leads emergency preparedness and disaster recovery planning for facilities operations and infrastructure systems.
  • Contributes to long‑term campus facilities and capital master planning, aligning operational initiatives with the University’s strategic growth and infrastructure needs.
  • Facilitates professional development opportunities for internal and external partners, fostering a culture of continuous learning and operational excellence across the facilities ecosystem.
  • Performs other duties as assigned in support of the University’s mission and campus environment.

Core Competencies

  • Expertise in higher education facilities management, contract negotiation, and budget administration.
  • Strong knowledge of building operations, energy management, and space utilization strategies.
  • Demonstrated leadership in managing large teams, service providers, and complex budgets.
  • Ability to develop long‑term strategies that balance financial sustainability with operational excellence.
  • Strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem‑solving skills with focus on accountability and innovation.
  • Commitment to service quality, timeliness, and the University’s mission.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business administration, architecture, or related field and eight (8) to ten (10) years of progressively responsible experience in facilities management, contract administration, and budget oversight; or a Master’s degree with five (5) years of directly related experience. Certified Educational Facilities Professional (CEFP) credential from the Association of Physical Plant Administrators (APPA) is strongly preferred, reflecting advanced expertise and commitment to professional excellence in educational facilities management.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Expected Salary Range: $170,000 - $190,000

title: Senior Manager, Workforce Planning & Operations
description:
Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Position

Workforce Strategy & Planning

  • Implement the strategic planning and oversight of Workforce Planning & Operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027)
  • Lead the end-to-end workforce planning process for the delivery of FWWC2027 to cover all workforce types at FIFA27 (paid staff, freelancers, tournament-time hires, secondees etc.)
  • Collaborate closely with the FIFA Workforce Management team to develop and manage an integrated workforce planning process, ensuring appropriate and optimized resources to deliver the agreed service levels.
  • Identify & assist with the development of all workforce types and define entitlements for each category.
  • Establish and communicate a centralised headcount plan to serve as the single source of truth for planning and access to data
  • Lead change management processes to support continuity in planning and execution
  • Input into the workforce overall budget, calendar and to the overall workforce strategy

Workforce Operations & Management

  • Deliver and manage the operational plans for all aspects of workforce operations at tournament time, including the design and delivery plan of site operations for workforce
  • Scope all physical operation spaces, overlay, technology and other requirements associated with workforce delivery on site
  • Develop and coordinate business process and scope of requirements for workforce systems to support on site operations at tournament-time
  • Contribute to and deliver the workforce operations role specific and venue specific training
  • Build and manage the schedule for the workforce operations team
  • Collaborate, support and motivate a large team of paid staff and volunteers who will deliver workforce operations on site
  • Collaborate with the wider workforce team on a day-to-day, operational basis
  • Manage logistics and operational requirements at tournament time such as office setup, internal communications, and event-time services (e.g. rewards, certificates, final match celebrations)
  • Coordinate with HR and leadership on sensitive personnel matters
  • Provide guidance and support to workforce operations venue managers at tournament-time
  • Draft and communicate policies and procedures to ensure a consistent and positive workforce experience during events
  • Define workforce service levels and contribute to the development of an entitlement’s matrix

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with cross-functional teams (e.g. Accommodation, Travel, Transport) to prioritise workforce needs
  • Build and maintain strong client focused relationships with all functional areas and work to update and confirm detailed site requirements for all areas.
  • Coordinate with wider workforce, HR and leadership on sensitive personnel matters

Technology & Innovation

  • Provide input into the development and optimisation of Workforce technology tools and platforms
  • Support digital transformation efforts to enhance workforce efficiency and communication

Profile

Work Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years of work experience, with at least 2 years in a similar role within workforce planning or operations at an international events and/or sports industry.
  • Strong knowledge of modern workforce planning systems, tools and practices.
  • Experience in leading operational venue teams at large-scale events
  • Expertise in data and decision making governance related to workforce planning in a complex environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to project manage, prioritize effectively, and work independently.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead team members and influence performance through positive leadership techniques.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrable adaptability and examples of where you’ve acted as a facilitator and/or negotiator.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organisation.

Technology

  • Proficient in MS Office tools (Word, PowerPoint, Visio & advanced Excel)
  • Proficiency in using project planning tools such as WeTrack and Monday.com
  • Experience with workforce system implementations advantageous

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual - Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

This includes working together with the relevant colleagues/internal customers to find SAP solutions to optimize the efficiency of sales distribution and finance processes, as well as the integration with other business processes and modules of SAP.

Availability to work at the Enerflex office in Rio de Janeiro – Brazil and travel within the regions.

Principle Responsibilities and Duties

  • Partner with the Finance/Tax and Procurement teams to understand business processes and gather business requirements.
  • Analyze, research and resolve requests submitted by the business using existing procedures, and ensuring the solution is aligned with corporate basis and/or local statutory purposes as AMS environment.
  • Map the end user business requirement with standard functionalities available in ERP.
  • Develop SAP knowledge/competency to LATAM functional end users throughout day-to-day business process flow.
  • Elaborate supporting process documentation.
  • Perform system regression testing for new releases or upgrades to SAP.
  • Coordinate testing and user acceptance.
  • Collaborate with other members of the SAP team on cross-functional solutions.
  • Facilitate integration with end-users and drive lean and continuous improvements to the system.
  • Support during month-end close period, making recommendations on existing solutions, and/or walk the business through business processes in existing LATAM Library.
  • Provide functional support for SAP SD/FI processes with emphasis on Brazil localization (tax determination, billing, legal requirements, and statutory compliance).

Support and validate billing and pricing scenarios impacted by Brazil tax rules and localization (e.g., non-taxpayer billing, tax code behavior, document output and compliance).

  • Coordinate regression testing and UAT for changes affecting Brazil processes (including refresh environments, releases, patches, and localization updates)
  • Trouble shooting and provide functional support for questions/issues/incidents and enhancements covering functionality area of Finance, Taxation, SD and MM related to Brazil Localization
  • Prepare and provide deskside or group training as required.
  • Escalate questions/issues/requests that cannot be resolved to Corp IT. Collaborate with ABAP and Finance Systems teams to translate functional requirements into clear technical specifications and ensure timely delivery.
  • Participate with Calgary SAP teams and Brazil Business Users to review issues, changes, and updates on periodical IT releases and SAP Security compliance.
  • Pass along updates to Finance/Tax and SD departments in Brazil (and LATAM region).
  • Test new release affecting the key modules for taxation and functional for Brazil and within LATAM. Review results affected users and get approval to promote changes to production if no issues encountered.

Qualifications

  • Solid functional experience in SAP SD with strong understanding of FI integration (billing → accounting, pricing/tax impacts, revenue-related flows).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills across all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrated exposure to Brazil tax/localization topics (indirect taxes, billing compliance, localization constraints and statutory behavior).
  • Experience supporting production environments (AMS-style) including incident triage, root cause analysis, and user-facing communication.
  • Excellent collaborator who can work with both business and technical resources.
  • Strong communication and organizational skills.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Business experience in a financial discipline would be a significant advantage.
  • Strong ability to manage and adapt to change.
  • Strong team player as well as ability to work well independently.
  • Ability to travel to our operating regions.
  • Prior experience with Brazil electronic invoicing / tax ecosystem integrations (e.g., NF-e related flows, interfaces, external tax providers).
  • Minimum 3-5 years related accounting experience.
  • Working experience in SAP S/4 HANA environments is a plus.
  • Growing and effective working knowledge of SAP and proficient with the Microsoft Office suite of products.
  • Proficient in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.

  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities to collaborate across diverse teams and locations.

description:

  • Formação superior em Farmácia, Química ou Engenharia Química.
  • Pacote Office intermediário.
  • Conhecimento das Boas Práticas de fabricação.

  • Desejável Inglês e espanhol.

Competências necessárias:

  • Resolução de problemas.

Qual será o seu desafio aqui:

  • Realizar análises físico-químicas de rotina no laboratório de controle de qualidade físico-químico de matérias-primas, granéis e produtos acabados.

  • Auxiliar nas investigações laboratoriais das análises e preenchimento de formulários de resultados fora do especificado (OOS), fora de tendência (OOT) e desvios (RD / RNC).
  • Executar análises de investigações correspondentes a desvios de qualidade e resultado fora da especificação.
  • Elaborar, revisar e ministrar treinamento do procedimento operacional padrão (POP) do controle da qualidade físico-químico.
  • Analisar monografias novas e revisadas e verificar necessidade de compra de consumíveis.
  • Preparar padrões de trabalho.

Oferecemos:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado.
  • Assistência Médica e odontológica Bradesco saúde com desconto mensal.
  • Convênio com Farmácia – Pacheco E Venâncio, com desconto em folha.
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo.
  • Previdência Privada.
  • Gympass.
  • Refeição no local.
  • Vale-alimentação no valor de R$ 550,00/mês.
  • Auxílio-creche para colaboradores do sexo feminino, com filhos até 2 anos.
  • Convênio com universidades.
  • Vale-Transporte.

Local de Trabalho: Turiaçu/RJ.

Horário de Trabalho: De Domingo a Quinta-feira das 14h às 23h30min.
